<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1800027_leve_sys_leave_request</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Set Approver from Manager</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    try {
        // Only run on new records or when employee changes
        if (!current.isNewRecord() && !current.employee.changes()) {
            return;
        }
        
        // Skip if approver is already set
        if (!current.approver.nil()) {
            gs.info("[Set Approver] Approver already set to: " + current.approver.getDisplayValue());
            return;
        }
        
        // Get employee details using GlideRecordSecure for security compliance
        var userGR = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_user');
        if (userGR.get(current.employee)) {
            // If employee has a manager set, use it as approver
            if (!userGR.manager.nil()) {
                current.approver = userGR.manager;
                gs.info("[Set Approver] Set approver to " + userGR.manager.getDisplayValue() + " from employee profile");
            } else {
                gs.info("[Set Approver] Employee has no manager set in profile");
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error("[Set Approver] Error: " + e);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-29 09:15:36</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>fab5269dc3cf6210a7f1b813e40131a0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Approver from Manager</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Leave Management System" source="x_1800027_leve_sys">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Leave Management System">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fab5269dc3cf6210a7f1b813e40131a0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-29 09:15:36</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=fab5269dc3cf6210a7f1b813e40131a0"/></record_update>
